description: Icon packages for Touying slides. Emoji (built-in) is recommended as the default. Each package directory contains a demo.typ showing usage with Touying simple theme.
recommendation: Use emoji (built-in) by default. Only use icon packages when you need specific icon sets (e.g., brand logos via Sicons, GitHub Octicons, CC license icons, social media links via Iconic Salmon).

icons.name: emoji
icons.description: Typst built-in emoji support — no package needed. Use emoji.xxx syntax or Unicode directly.
icons.import: Built-in, no import needed. Use #emoji.xxx syntax.

icons.name: sicons
icons.description: Simple Icons — high quality SVG icons for popular brands (Typst, GitHub, Python, etc.).
icons.best_for: Brand logos and icons for popular services

icons.name: ccicons
icons.description: Creative Commons license icons for Typst — CC BY, CC NC, CC SA, CC ND, etc.

icons.name: octique
icons.description: GitHub Octicons for Typst — official GitHub icon set including AI/Copilot, Git, and developer icons.

icons.name: iconic-salmon-svg
icons.description: Social media reference icons with links — GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter, etc. Great for CV/resume slides.
icons.best_for: Social media links, CV slides, contact info

icons.name: booticons
icons.description: Bootstrap Icons (v1.13.1) — 2000+ icons from the Bootstrap project.
